title: Initial target definition for a 300,000 RMB parcel sorting cell
summary: Defines the first product node, core modules, key metrics, and intended closed-loop demo for low-cost parcel sorting.
limitations: Internal planning evidence only; not a field benchmark or vendor-verified cost.

title: Vendor claims for modular parcel sorting cells and conveyor diverters
sourceName: Representative vendor materials to be reviewed
summary: Placeholder evidence for commercially available sorting cell components and diverter-style routes.
limitations: Unreviewed vendor-style claim; needs replacement with specific product pages, quotes, and field cases.

title: Placeholder field case for parcel variability, jam rate, and operator intervention
summary: Tracks the need for field evidence about parcel mix, exception rates, and operational reliability.
limitations: Placeholder only; should be replaced by real deployment data.

title: Placeholder cost model for low-cost hardware stack
summary: Records that the 300,000 RMB target requires explicit BOM, integration, installation, and maintenance assumptions.
limitations: No priced BOM yet.

title: Servo Motor Technology overview
summary: Describes servo motor structure including stator, winding, bearing, shaft, rotor, encoder, encoder cable, and motor cable; also describes encoder feedback and driver control role.
limitations: Vendor educational source; good for structure but not enough for cost, BOM pricing, factory yield, or robot-specific reliability.

title: Your First AC Servo training material
summary: Training material describing rotary AC servo motor structure as stator, rotor, and encoder, with notes on wire wrapped around the stator core, permanent-magnet rotor, encoder position detection, and brake types.
limitations: Training material, not a detailed manufacturing process source; assembly/test and feedback alignment claims remain low confidence.

title: Synchronous Servo Motors
summary: Product page describing brushless permanent-magnet electronically commutated synchronous servo motors, optimized stator/rotor design, torque density, low heat generation, encoder feedback options, compact housing, and robotic-arm applications.
limitations: Vendor product page; useful for candidate structure and integration constraints but not neutral benchmark evidence.

title: Servo motors
summary: Product page describing servo motors with neodymium-iron-boron permanent magnet rotors, optional incremental or absolute encoders, and cost optimization through integrated motor/gear/brake/encoder options.
limitations: Vendor product page; does not quantify 300,000 RMB robot BOM impact or supply-chain risk.

title: Stator & Rotor Encoders
summary: Describes encoder stator/rotor components, precision etched patterns, optical/magnetic/inductive sensing, tolerance/flatness concerns, and robotics or industrial motor feedback applications.
limitations: Component manufacturing vendor source; supports encoder component constraints but not complete servo motor factory flow.

title: Harmonic Drive strain-wave gear technology
summary: Describes strain-wave gear components including wave generator, flexspline, and circular spline, and explains zero-backlash precision behavior relevant to robot joint reducers.
limitations: Vendor educational source; supports reducer architecture but not neutral cost, fatigue, field failure, or local supplier evidence.

title: Vision Sensor Components
summary: Describes core machine-vision components such as lighting, lens, image sensor, processor, and communication elements, supporting the decomposition of parcel label recognition hardware.
limitations: Machine-vision vendor source; supports component structure but not parcel-specific no-read rates, glare/occlusion performance, or 300,000 RMB BOM fit.

title: Conveying and Sortation
summary: Describes sensors, vision sensors, sensing arrays, barcode readers, LED lights, conveyor motor cycling, product spacing, parcel tracking, destination verification, and chute jam confirmation in conveying and sortation.
limitations: Vendor application page; good for sensor/control roles but not full system economics or field reliability benchmark.

title: Robotic Parcel Induct installation manual
summary: Installation manual for a robotic parcel induction system describing a standard vacuum gripper with nine suction cups and suction-cup patterns, supporting parcel end-effector decomposition.
limitations: Vendor installation manual for a specific product; useful for architecture but not sufficient for low-cost generic gripper reliability, wear, or parcel mix limits.

title: Vacuum end-of-arm tooling components
summary: Describes vacuum end-of-arm tooling components such as suction cups, cups with fittings, vacuum generators, valves, manifolds, and system accessories relevant to suction-based parcel grippers.
limitations: Vendor catalog/application source; supports component candidates but not parcel-specific pickup success, contamination, energy use, or maintenance cost.

title: MELSERVO-J4 servo amplifier safety features
summary: Describes servo amplifier safety sub-functions including Safe Torque Off and Safe Stop 1, and supports the role of servo amplifier electronics in safe robot motion.
limitations: Vendor feature page; supports safety-function presence but not complete power-stage design, cost, thermal margin, or multi-axis robot cabinet integration.

title: SINAMICS servo drive motion control
summary: Describes a modular high-performance drive system for demanding motion-control applications with speed, torque, and position control, supporting servo drive control-loop and integration decomposition.
limitations: Vendor overview; supports motion-control function but not detailed firmware, current-sensor BOM, EMC test process, or low-cost Chinese supply chain.

title: High-performance sorters for unit handling
summary: Describes sorter platforms for cartons and parcels, destination platforms, sorter controls, infeed elements, chutes, mechanical robustness, maintenance, and operating-cost considerations.
limitations: Vendor platform page for larger sortation systems; useful for conveyor/sortation integration roles but not proof that this exact 300,000 RMB robot cell is affordable.

title: Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
summary: USGS annual mineral commodity reference covering production, reserves, resources, and trade for more than 90 mineral commodities, including copper, iron ore, bauxite/alumina/aluminum, and related mineral supply chains.
limitations: Commodity-level mineral reference; does not prove component-specific BOM quantities, supplier selection, or delivered cost for the 300,000 RMB robot.

title: Silicon Statistics and Information
summary: USGS silicon commodity page describing quartz or quartzite as input to silicon ferroalloys and silicon metal, silicon metal use in aluminum alloying and chemicals, and small quantities processed into high-purity silicon for semiconductors.
limitations: Commodity-level source; supports silicon chain existence but not specific chip fabrication node, fab capacity, export controls, or electronics BOM pricing.

title: Rare Earth Elements critical resources
summary: USGS rare-earth fact sheet describing rare-earth elements, deposits, and high-technology uses including permanent magnet alloys containing neodymium, samarium, gadolinium, dysprosium, or praseodymium.
limitations: Older general USGS fact sheet; useful for material identity but should be paired with current production, processing, and magnet supply-chain evidence.

title: Rare Earth Elements executive summary
summary: IEA summary describing high-performance NdFeB magnets as primarily composed of neodymium and praseodymium, often with dysprosium and terbium as performance-enhancing additives, and noting demand growth from electrification.
limitations: Sector-level analysis; does not quantify the amount of rare earth material in this robot's servo motors or prove actual supplier availability.

title: Iron and Steel Manufacturing
summary: DOE overview distinguishing steel production routes, including remelting scrap in electric arc furnaces and production from iron ore using blast furnaces and basic oxygen furnaces.
limitations: Process-level overview; does not identify exact steel grades, heat treatment, cleanliness requirements, or component machining tolerances.
